title: Make the rule scanner fence-aware and fix the stale cap help text
action: Two fixes that Phase 4's migration needs first. (1) Per D4, the rule marker/reference scanner must not read a QUOTED marker as a home: check.rs:465 `extract_rule_markers` and :484 `extract_rule_refs` are plain text scans; route both through check.rs:237 `strip_code_regions` (fenced blocks and inline backticks stripped) before matching, so conformance-check.md's literal `<!-- rule: <id> -->` and `(rule: <id>)` examples inside backticks stop registering as a home and a reference. Keep ownership.rs's callers working (it reuses extract_rule_markers). Tests: a file whose only marker is inside backticks or a fence yields no home and no ref; a real marker beside a quoted one yields exactly one. (2) The inventoried stale copy: the `cells cap` help text in src/generated/registry_payload.json still says 'Tests prove at the boundary — `bee close` runs commands.test when the feature has no worktree, `bee worktree merge` runs it when it does' (rg -n 'Tests prove at the boundary' there) — that rule was retired (caps record a proof line; close/merge check it and run nothing, rule id agents-proof-at-cap homed in AGENTS.md). Rewrite that sentence to one line stating the live rule plus `(rule: agents-proof-at-cap)`; check `cells finish` and `close` descriptions for the same stale phrasing and fix them the same way. Catalog count only if the drift test moves. Sync conformance-check.md: state that markers and refs are read outside code regions.
